description: "The Trumpeter of Säkkingen: A Song from the Upper Rhine" by Joseph Victor von Scheffel is a poetic novel written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: This work tells the story of young Werner, a talented musician, who embarks on a journey through the picturesque landscapes of the Schwarzwald and the Rhine.

authorInfo.bio: Joseph Victor von Scheffel (1826–1886) wrote The Trumpeter of Säkkingen: A Song from the Upper Rhine.. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
